name: Privacy-First Invoice Generator
summary: Browser-based invoice editor: fill in an invoice and export it as a PDF, with data saved locally on your device.
description: An invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses. Fill in seller and buyer details, line items, discounts, taxes and shipping, preview the result and generate a PDF. Data stays in the browser's local storage; invoices can be saved, loaded and imported/exported as text files. Supports 30 currencies and 16 languages.
contains: free invoice generator; data stays in the browser local storage
PDF invoice generation with live preview
line items, discounts, taxes and shipping (percentage or amount)
custom fields for seller and buyer, notes and payment terms
import/export invoices as text files; saved invoices list
